Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub.: Intimation of Analyst Meet 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you of the Analyst meeting scheduled as per the details given 
below: 
 
Date  
Interaction with/Event Name 
Place/Mode Nature of Meet 
August 17, 2026 
Motilal Oswal 22nd Annual Global Investor 
Conference organised by Motilal Oswal 
Financial Services Ltd. 
In-person 
(Mumbai) 
Group meet 
 
Please note that the above is subject to change. 
 
The Company uses its latest corporate presentation for the meetings. A copy of the same is available on the 
Company’s website - https://www.crisil.com/content/crisilcom/en/home/investors/analyst-hub.html and has also 
been sent to the Stock Exchange on July 21, 2026. 
 
Kindly take this communication on record. 
 
Yours faithfully,      
For Crisil Limited
